title: Three promises. Each starts from work already done.
cta: Which promise matters most to you?

one.title: Open NGAAF
one.do1: Publish every NGAAF allocation by ward and financial year
one.do2: Open, scheduled application windows for women's groups
one.do3: Quarterly report-backs in all five constituencies
one.record: Raised tea weights and measures for smallholder farmers in the Senate (25 May 2023). [[TO CONFIRM: official source for the Woman Rep's NGAAF role and her Bomet allocations, 2017–2022]]

two.title: Safe girls, safe homes
two.do1: Push for GBV response desks reachable from every ward
two.do2: Work with schools, chiefs and elders on defilement reporting
two.do3: Track cases to court and report the numbers publicly
two.record: Raised gender-based and domestic violence in Bomet on the Senate floor (8 October 2026). [[TO CONFIRM: Kenya News Agency report on defilement and teen pregnancy — original link now returns 404]]

three.title: Teachers & libraries
three.do1: Champion ECDE teacher welfare and terms
three.do2: Follow the County Library Services law through to libraries in Bomet
three.do3: Back bursaries that keep girls in secondary school
three.record: Sponsored the County Library Services Bill (passed the Senate, 25 February 2026). Raised Bomet ECDE teachers' welfare (22 February 2024).
